question: As of December 2020, there are ______ official languages of the United Nations.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**6**__.

__
 
• As of **December 2020**, there are **6 official languages** of the **United Nations.**
 
• These are **Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian** and** Spanish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The history of the** UN’s official languages**, presented by the **Dag Hammarskjold Library,** gives the history of when each of the **six official languages** of the **United Nations** became official, beginning in **1946.**
 
• The **United Nations** is one of the **world’s largest employers** of** language professionals**.
 
• Several hundred language professionals work for the** Department **for **General Assembly **and** Conference Management** (DGACM) in **New York, Geneva, Vienna,** and **Nairobi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Language Days at the UN are:**__

 __
 
• Arabic Language Day (18 December)
 
• Chinese Language Day (20 April)
 
• English Language Day (23 April)
 
• French Language Day (20 March)
 
• Russian Language Day (6 June)
 
• Spanish Language Day (23 April) 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **United Nations** is an intergovernmental organization aiming to maintain international **peace and security.**
 
• The **United Nations **was founded on** 24 October 1945 in San Francisco, California, United States**.
 
• The United Nations general secretary is** Antonio Guterres **and its headquarters is located in **New York, United States.**
